text:
maria: FYI customer reported duplicate billing after a truncated streaming session + reconnect where a toolcall replay confirmed provisional credits twice.
kevin: any logs or repro ids?
maria: yes. router handed off to region-b with provisional pvA, client reconnected to region-c and router created pvB; later reconciler confirmed both. logs: [router-1 HANDOFF session=svc-9 last_ack=210 provisional=pvA] -> [client reconnect resume=210 -> router-2 PROVISIONAL_CREATE provisional=pvB] -> reconciler CONFIRM [pvA,pvB]. double charge.
sara: do provisional entries carry handoff or downstream ids today?
maria: no, only session + offset + provisional id. handoff_id exists in routing but isn't persisted.
alex: short-term mitigation: router should check for existing provisional for session+offset on resume and skip creating a new ledger entry (mark deduped). cheap fix.
sara: long-term: 1) include handoff_id/session_origin in provisional metadata, 2) reconciler groups provisional entries by session_origin_id so only one is confirmed, 3) console surfaces provisional vs confirmed and excludes provisional from billed totals until confirmed. UI: show provisional row with tooltip.
kevin: also add telemetry provisional_created{region,route} and resume_count tag; alert on provisional spike.
maria: edge-case: truncation + toolcall TTL can leave orphaned provisional if downstream never accepts before reconnect. need GC/tombstone or TTL for provisionals.
alex: i'll review storage cost of adding handoff_id and propose schema change.
maria: I'll own reconciler grouping RFC and attach traces.
kevin: i'll pick the router dedupe PR and push to staging.
sara: i'll mock console changes and dashboard panels.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/prov-dedupe -> staging at 2026-03-19T03:00Z. :rocket:
